title: A Year of Us: Sunsets, Sea & Goa

elements.content: As I conclude this year, I got another chance to open this diary. And reason is to record my second trip with my travel partner. Occasion was our first wedding anniversary. This trip was also our sudden trip just like Thailand. For some strange reasons, I believe that when you properly wholeheartedly plan something, some uncertain things happen to hinder your plans. (still I love to plan in detail) So, we planned this trip just 10-15 days before our anniversary. We were supposed to travel on 21st December & something happened on 17th December. All our plans were dicey if we’ll make it or not. But at last, plan executed.

elements.content: We got up early & left home around 4 am in the morning. It was very cold due to winter, but I love this season, so I was fine with it. I was excited as I was visiting goa for the first time Yes! People visit Goa like it’s their Hometown once or twice a year, but I had never been to that place before. So yes, I was excited that finally I’m visiting the most popular & Go-to place of all bachelors. lol! But come to think of it, I felt I was destined to visit Goa with my husband & at the age of 29.

elements.content: We reached Dadar station by 4:50 am in the morning. Our train was scheduled to leave at 5:35 am. It was also my first time to board Vande Bharat. Experience of Vande Bharat is a class. I have always travelled from the cheapest transport all over my life. So this was my lavish transport whatsoever. We reached Goa in the afternoon. Weather was not as good as I expected. I was expecting cold breezes, chill atmosphere, windy climate, fogg and what not because I was seeing complete fogg outside the train. So I was expecting it to be like that at my destination as well. However, when I got down from the train it was as unpleasant as Mumbai. Little hot & humid.

elements.content: It was one of the highly recommended tourist spots according to google. So we gave it a shot & experienced it. I would not say it was bad, but it wasn’t good either. It was average. Photos were nice & captured good sunset in our memories.

elements.content: Second day I had pretty cute day. We didn’t do anything much till afternoon. After having little lunch, (yes I ate like nothing for the sake of my crop top) we started our day 2 rides. We headed straight to Don Bosco church which was about 30-35 kms. I rode scooty for what like 1 hour and a half hour, I guess. I was fully covered on the bike with jackets and masks and caps, I think I was looking like someone without any fashion sense with so many things on. My neon green cord set, my white shoes, Gray jacket, dark blue scarf , brown & beige colour bag & helmet. But who cares! Health & safety comes first.

elements.content: We covered 4 points that day like Don Bosco Church, Mangeshi temple, fontainhas (Well, Nilesh kept it a secret from me initially but I found it eventually) & Dona Paula in almost 6 hours with each spot at a distance of 25-30 kms far from each other. Overall I rode for minimum 80-90 Kms that day. Last spot we went to was Dona Paula where Singham was shot. We thought it would be a great place. But it failed our expectations. The place was very small, not as big as shown in the movie. 😒

elements.content: But we went on top. And stayed there for couple of minutes listening to the sound of waves coming from all unknown dark corners from the bottom. That was both chilling and scary. Whenever I see ocean in the night, only thing comes to my mind is Titanic. Imagine getting lost in the ocean without having any sight of humans around. I get goosebumps every time I look at dark ocean 🌊🤐

elements.content: Later we had some food & went on for rest of the activities. We were very near to some beach but inside the water where rest of the activities were supposed to happen. elements.content: We did Scooba diving there. Firstly, I was scared of going down but when Nilesh went in & said I should also give a try, I somehow gathered courage and went inside. We saw beautiful fishes, but it was only 1-2 species, if I had stayed longer they would have taken me little more deeper which I could not. So, 30 seconds into the water & I was up already. Sea water was extremely salty.

elements.content: I did hair braiding on both the sides. That’s like a women ritual in goa. Every  alternate girl was with those braids. I did temporary tattoo as well. (of BTS’s Love Yourself of course!) It was just a temporary tattoo (& I'm planning to get the same permanently in near future). After tattoo is done, we went to Baga Beach & entire beach was covered in yellow, green, red, shimmery, glittery lights. I love such shiny vibes. And I just love warm lights. So entire beach was decorated just the way I like. We decided to come there next day so we could get exact moment of 25th December at 12 am. While coming back from the beach, we started feeling hungry. We roamed around & stopped at one restaurant. Had food there & took leftovers, grabbed some drink & went into the room. We wanted to taste wine but there was only big bottle available it seemed in entire Goa.

elements.caption: This was my first snow experience which was not even real😅

elements.content: Next day was going to be the last day of our trip. We got up little late only after that we went to see the Snow Park in Goa. That was not exactly my bucket list but yes being in the minus temperature & experience snow was one from my wish list. So, partially I completed that. I experience it “-5” degree Celsius temperature. I had no clue how cold snow parks usually are, so I wore my black hot pants. And as expected, my thighs were like a frozen meat. I was completely packed except my thighs. Even though I was freezing, I had enjoyed that moment and captured beautiful pictures. Tickets was for unlimited time, but we could not stay for more than 45 mins.
